settings.style.label: Indicator style
settings.style.description: Show one marker per column, with a highlight for the focused window.
settings.dot_shape.label: Dot shape
settings.dot_shape.description: Choose round or square column markers.
settings.dot_size.label: Dot size (px)
settings.dot_size.description: Width and height of each dot in logical pixels.
settings.dot_spacing.label: Dot spacing (px)
settings.fill_inactive_dots.label: Fill unfocused dots
settings.fill_inactive_dots.description: Fill unfocused column markers instead of outlining them.
settings.segment_length.label: Segment length (px)
settings.segment_length.description: Length of each column marker along the bar.
settings.line_thickness.label: Line thickness (px)
settings.line_thickness.description: Thickness of the line across the bar.
settings.line_gap.label: Segment gap (px)
settings.line_gap.description: Use 0 for a continuous line, or increase for separate dashes.
settings.line_radius.label: Segment corner radius (px)
settings.line_radius.description: Round each segment’s corners. Use 0 for square corners.
settings.outer_radius.label: Outer end radius (px)
settings.outer_radius.description: Round the two outside ends independently of the segment corners.
settings.alignment.label: Alignment
settings.alignment.description: Center the indicator or align it to an edge. Top and bottom become left and right on vertical bars.
settings.alignment_size.label: Bar thickness (px)
settings.alignment_size.description: Available space across the bar. With widget scaling, divide the bar thickness by the scale.
settings.edge_inset.label: Distance from edge (px)
settings.edge_inset.description: Space between the indicator and the selected edge.
settings.active_scale.label: Focused marker size (%)
settings.active_scale.description: 100% keeps the normal size; 200% doubles both dimensions without changing marker spacing.
settings.use_theme_colors.label: Use theme colors
settings.use_theme_colors.description: Use the theme primary color for the focused column and secondary text color for unfocused columns.
settings.focused_color.label: Focused column color
settings.focused_color.description: Color of the column containing the focused window. Choose a theme role or a custom color.
settings.inactive_color.label: Unfocused column color
settings.inactive_color.description: Color of columns that do not contain the focused window. Choose a theme role or a custom color.
settings.inactive_opacity.label: Unfocused opacity
settings.inactive_opacity.description: Lower values fade unfocused columns. Hovering a column restores its full opacity.
settings.hover_scale.label: Marker size on hover (%)
settings.hover_scale.description: 100% keeps the normal size. When focused and hovered, the larger size wins.
settings.hover_highlight.label: Show hover highlight
settings.hover_highlight.description: Show a colored highlight under the pointer. Turn off to keep tooltips and marker scaling without the highlight.
settings.hover_opacity.label: Highlight opacity
settings.hover_opacity.description: Strength of the hover highlight. Use 0 to hide it while keeping window-title tooltips.
settings.hover_use_theme_color.label: Use theme highlight color
settings.hover_use_theme_color.descripti: Use the theme foreground color for the hover highlight.
settings.hover_color.label: Highlight color
settings.hover_color.description: Color of the hover highlight. Choose a theme role or a custom color.
settings.hover_coverage.label: Highlight length (%)
settings.hover_coverage.description: Percentage of the marker length covered, centered within the marker.
settings.hover_thickness.label: Highlight thickness (px)
settings.hover_thickness.description: Use 0 to follow the marker size. Larger values also enlarge the hover target.
settings.hover_radius.label: Highlight corner radius (px)
settings.hover_radius.description: Corner rounding of the hover highlight.
settings.animations.label: Enable animations
settings.animations.description: Animate focus changes and column arrivals and departures. Noctalia’s global animation switch also applies.
settings.animation_style.label: Transition style
settings.animation_style.description: Choose how the focus highlight moves between columns.
settings.animation_duration.label: Duration (ms)
settings.animation_duration.description: Adjusted by Noctalia’s animation speed. For Bouncy, sets spring response time; settling may take longer.
settings.animation_curve.label: Motion curve
settings.animation_curve.description: Choose the pace of focus transitions and column fade-ins. Curve tuning is available under Show advanced.
settings.curve_power.label: Easing power
settings.curve_power.description: Fine-tune Ease in, Ease out, or Ease in-out. Higher values strengthen acceleration or deceleration.
settings.curve_exponential.label: Exponential strength
settings.curve_exponential.description: Fine-tune Exponential out. Higher values move faster at the start and settle more slowly.
settings.curve_bounce_strength.label: Bounce depth
settings.curve_bounce_strength.descripti: Fine-tune Bouncy. Use 0 to settle without overshoot; higher values give a deeper rebound.
settings.curve_x1.label: Bézier X1
settings.curve_x1.description: Time coordinate of the first control point, from 0 to 1.
settings.curve_y1.label: Bézier Y1
settings.curve_y1.description: Progress coordinate of the first control point, from 0 to 1.
settings.curve_x2.label: Bézier X2
settings.curve_x2.description: Time coordinate of the second control point, from 0 to 1.
settings.curve_y2.label: Bézier Y2
settings.curve_y2.description: Progress coordinate of the second control point, from 0 to 1.
settings.slide_fluidity.label: Slide stretch
settings.slide_fluidity.description: Applies to Slide with the Bouncy curve. Use 0 for a fixed-length highlight, or increase to stretch it during travel.
